remarks: Experience luxury living in this spacious and inviting condominium, perfectly situated along the stunning waterfront of Schooner Cove. This residence features two generously sized bedrooms plus a loft, providing ample space for rest and relaxation. Recent updates include a brand new refrigerator, stove, microwave, and dishwasher and wine fridge, ensuring modern conveniences at your fingertips. Each bedroom is adorned with large windows, allowing natural light to flood the space and create a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The well-designed layout showcases an open-concept living area that effortlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen spaces-perfect for both casual living and entertaining guests. Located in a prime area, this condo offers easy access to Stamford's vibrant downtown, where you'll find a diverse array of dining, shopping, and entertainment options just moments away. Commuters will appreciate the convenient access to major highways and public transportation, along with nearby walking trails and a beach, making travel to neighboring cities or New York City a breeze. Apartment comes with a one car garage and ample parking in the secure lot. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to enjoy waterfront living in Schooner Cove!
